axis.labelEn: Does an object in mid-airspace count as having come to rest?

application.cueHe: וְרַבָּנַן סָבְרִי לָא אָמְרִינַן ״קְלוּטָה כְּמִי שֶׁהוּנְּחָה דָּמְיָא״
application.evidenceEn: The Rabbis hold that we do not say an object passing through a domain's airspace is considered at rest.
